server.name: coingecko-mcp-app
server.title: CoinGecko
server.description: MCP server exposing CoinGecko cryptocurrency market data (prices, market caps, volume) as tools and widgets.

live.instructions: Route crypto requests to the right tool: get-coin-markets for current price/market data on specific coins or a top-N leaderboard; compare-coins when the user wants to compare or contrast 2–4 specific coins side by side (phrasing like "compare", "vs", "versus", "contrast", e.g. "BTC vs ETH") — prefer it over get-coin-markets for these; get-coin-market-chart for a single coin's price history / chart over a range (renders an interactive chart widget); get-coin-history for a coin's price, market cap and volume on a specific past date (a point-in-time snapshot); get-coin-info for what a coin *is* — its description, categories/sectors, official links and launch date (project background, not prices); get-trending for what's hot right now; get-categories for how crypto sectors/narratives (DeFi, Layer 1, memes, AI, RWA…) are performing — a ranked leaderboard of categories by market cap or 24h change (sectors/themes, not individual coins like get-trending and not the whole market like get-global-market); get-global-market for overall market health (total market cap, dominance); get-top-gainers-losers for what's pumping or dumping today (requires a Pro key); get-crypto-news for recent crypto news headlines — global, or filtered to one coin — presented verbatim, never summarized as bullish/bearish (not for what a coin is, use get-coin-info, and not for hot coins, use get-trending); search-coins to resolve an ambiguous ticker or name to a CoinGecko id before calling the others. Map user tickers and names to CoinGecko ids yourself (e.g. BTC → bitcoin). None of these tools give financial advice — always present the data neutrally and never recommend buying, selling, or holding.

tools.name: get-coin-markets
tools.title: Get coin market data
tools.description: Get current market data (price, market cap, 24h volume, market cap rank) for a list of CoinGecko coin ids, or for the top N coins by market cap, and display it in a visual widget. Provide either ids or topN, not both. Use this when the user asks for the price or market data of specific coins, or for a top-N leaderboard by market cap. To compare or contrast 2–4 specific coins (e.g. "BTC vs ETH"), use compare-coins instead. Not for historical prices (use get-coin-market-chart) and not financial advice.

ids.description: CoinGecko coin *ids* (not tickers), e.g. ["bitcoin", "ethereum", "solana", "zcash"]. Up to 20. Map user tickers/names to ids yourself.

topN.description: Return the top N coins by market cap (1–20). Provide either ids or topN, not both; ids wins if both are given.

image.description: URL to the coin's logo image

currentPrice.description: Current price in USD, or null if unavailable

marketCap.description: Market capitalization in USD, or null if unavailable

marketCapRank.description: Market cap rank, or null if unranked

totalVolume.description: 24h trading volume in USD, or null if unavailable

priceChangePercentage24h.description: 24h price change percentage, or null if unavailable

fullyDilutedValuation.description: Fully diluted valuation in USD, or null if unavailable

circulatingSupply.description: Circulating supply in coin units, or null if unavailable

maxSupply.description: Max supply in coin units, or null if uncapped/unavailable

sparkline7d.description: 7-day price series in USD (downsampled, oldest first)

coins.description: Market data for each requested coin

tools.name: compare-coins
tools.title: Compare coins
tools.description: Compare 2–4 coins side by side — price, market cap, FDV, multi-window price change (1h/24h/7d/30d), volume, supply, distance from all-time high — in a visual widget. Use this when the user asks to compare, contrast, or pit specific coins against each other (phrasing like 'compare', 'vs', 'versus', 'against', e.g. 'BTC vs ETH vs SOL'). Map tickers to ids yourself. Not for a single coin (use get-coin-markets) and not financial advice.

ids.description: Two to four CoinGecko coin *ids* (not tickers) to compare, e.g. ["bitcoin", "ethereum", "solana"]. Map user tickers/names to ids yourself.

image.description: URL to the coin's logo image

currentPrice.description: Current price in USD, or null if unavailable

marketCap.description: Market capitalization in USD, or null if unavailable

marketCapRank.description: Market cap rank, or null if unranked

totalVolume.description: 24h trading volume in USD, or null if unavailable

priceChangePercentage1h.description: 1h price change percentage, or null if unavailable

priceChangePercentage24h.description: 24h price change percentage, or null if unavailable

priceChangePercentage7d.description: 7d price change percentage, or null if unavailable

priceChangePercentage30d.description: 30d price change percentage, or null if unavailable

athChangePercentage.description: Percentage below the all-time high (negative), or null if unavailable

volumeToMarketCap.description: Derived liquidity ratio: 24h volume divided by market cap, or null if either is unavailable

marketCapVsLargest.description: Derived: this coin's market cap divided by the largest in the set (1.0 for the largest), or null if unavailable

fullyDilutedValuation.description: Fully diluted valuation in USD, or null if unavailable

circulatingSupply.description: Circulating supply in coin units, or null if unavailable

maxSupply.description: Max supply in coin units, or null if uncapped/unavailable

sparkline7d.description: 7-day price series in USD (downsampled, oldest first)

coins.description: The compared coins, in the order requested (2–4)

tools.name: get-coin-market-chart
tools.title: Get coin market chart
tools.description: Get a single coin's historical price over a date range and display it as an interactive chart widget (filled area chart with a price/market-cap toggle and a 24h–Max range selector). Use this whenever the user wants a chart, graph, or price history for one coin — e.g. 'bitcoin chart', 'ETH price last 90 days', 'how has SOL moved this year'. Not for the current spot price of one or more coins (use get-coin-markets) and not financial advice.

id.description: CoinGecko coin id the chart data belongs to

days.description: Date range used for this chart's price series

prices.description: Price series in USD, oldest first

marketCaps.description: Market cap series in USD, oldest first (parallel to prices)

startTs.description: Unix ms timestamp of the first price point, or null if empty

endTs.description: Unix ms timestamp of the last price point, or null if empty

tools.name: get-coin-history
tools.title: Get coin history
tools.description: Get a coin's price, market cap and 24h volume on a specific past date (snapshot at 00:00 UTC). Use this when the user asks what a coin was worth on a given date, e.g. 'BTC price on Jan 1 2024'. Not for current prices (use get-coin-markets) or price ranges over time (use get-coin-market-chart), and not financial advice.

date.description: Snapshot date, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Must be a past date on or after 2013-04-28; for today's price use get-coin-markets.

vsCurrency.description: Fiat quote currency (lowercase ISO code). Defaults to usd.
Fiat currency the monetary fields are denominated in

price.description: Price at the snapshot, or null if unavailable

marketCap.description: Market cap at the snapshot, or null

totalVolume.description: 24h volume at the snapshot, or null

tools.name: get-coin-info
tools.title: Get coin info
tools.description: Get descriptive project information about a coin: what it is (a short description), its categories/sectors, official links (website, explorer, Twitter/X, Reddit, GitHub, Telegram) and launch date. Use this when the user asks what a coin *is* or wants background on a project, e.g. 'what is Chainlink?' or 'tell me about Solana'. Not for prices or market data (use get-coin-markets) and not financial advice.

image.description: URL to the coin's logo image ('' if none)

descriptionExcerpt.description: Plain-text project description, HTML-stripped and clamped ('' if none)

categories.description: Sector/narrative labels this coin belongs to

genesisDate.description: Launch date (YYYY-MM-DD), or null if unknown

tools.name: search-coins
tools.title: Search coins
tools.description: Search CoinGecko for coins by name or ticker and return their coin ids. Use this when the user names a coin you cannot confidently map to a CoinGecko id, or when a ticker is ambiguous. Prefer the highest-ranked match. Not for prices — call get-coin-markets with the resolved id.

query.description: Coin name or ticker to search, e.g. 'bitcoin' or 'ethereum'

id.description: CoinGecko coin id to use with other tools

marketCapRank.description: Market cap rank, or null if unranked

thumb.description: URL to a small coin logo image

tools.name: get-trending
tools.title: Get trending coins
tools.description: Get the coins trending on CoinGecko in the last 24 hours and display them in a visual widget. Use this when the user asks what's hot, trending, or popular right now. Not for prices of specific coins (use get-coin-markets) and not financial advice.

image.description: URL to the coin's logo image

marketCapRank.description: Market cap rank, or null if unranked

price.description: Current price in USD, or null if unavailable

priceChangePercentage24h.description: 24h price change percentage, or null if unavailable

coins.description: Coins trending on CoinGecko in the last 24 hours

tools.name: get-categories
tools.title: Get crypto categories
tools.description: Get a ranked leaderboard of crypto categories (sectors/narratives like DeFi, Layer 1, memes, AI, RWA) by total market cap and 24h change, and display it in a visual widget. Use this when the user asks which sectors, narratives, or themes are hot, big, or moving. Order by market cap (default) or 24h change. Not for individual trending coins (use get-trending) or overall market health (use get-global-market), and not financial advice.

order.description: Sort dimension: 'market_cap' for the largest sectors (default), 'market_cap_change_24h' for the hottest sectors by 24h change.

marketCap.description: Total market cap of the category in USD, or null if unavailable

marketCapChange24h.description: 24h market cap change percentage, or null if unavailable

volume24h.description: 24h trading volume of the category in USD, or null if unavailable

id.description: CoinGecko coin id of a top coin in this category

image.description: URL to that coin's logo image

topCoins.description: Up to three of the category's largest coins (id + logo)

categories.description: Crypto sectors/narratives, ranked by the requested order

tools.name: get-global-market
tools.title: Get global market data
tools.description: Get a snapshot of the overall crypto market: total market cap, 24h change, total volume, BTC/ETH dominance, plus current price and 24h change for the top-cap coins (BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB, XRP). Use this when the user asks how the crypto market is doing overall. For prices of other/arbitrary coins, use get-coin-markets.

marketCapChangePercentage24hUsd.description: 24h market cap change percentage in USD, or null if unavailable

totalVolumeUsd.description: Total 24h trading volume in USD, or null if unavailable

btcDominancePct.description: Bitcoin's share of total market cap, or null if unavailable

ethDominancePct.description: Ethereum's share of total market cap, or null if unavailable

image.description: URL to the coin's logo image

currentPrice.description: Current price in USD, or null if unavailable

priceChangePercentage24h.description: 24h price change percentage, or null if unavailable

coins.description: Top-cap coins (BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB, XRP) with price and 24h change

tools.name: get-top-gainers-losers
tools.title: Get top gainers and losers
tools.description: Get the top gaining and top losing coins over a time window and display them in a visual widget. Use this when the user asks what's pumping, dumping, or moving today. Not for a single coin's price (use get-coin-markets). Data only — never frame as a buy/sell signal. Requires a CoinGecko Pro API key.

price.description: Current price in USD, or null if unavailable

changePct.description: Price change percentage over the requested duration, or null if unavailable

marketCapRank.description: Market cap rank, or null if unranked

image.description: URL to the coin's logo image

price.description: Current price in USD, or null if unavailable

changePct.description: Price change percentage over the requested duration, or null if unavailable

marketCapRank.description: Market cap rank, or null if unranked

tools.name: get-crypto-news
tools.title: Get crypto news
tools.description: Get recent crypto news headlines — global, or filtered to one coin via coinId. Use this when the user asks for the latest news, headlines, or updates about crypto in general or about a specific coin. Headlines and links are presented verbatim; never summarized as bullish/bearish and never financial advice. Not for what a coin is (use get-coin-info) or price data (use get-coin-markets).

coinId.description: CoinGecko coin id to filter news to, e.g. 'bitcoin'. Omit for global headlines. Map user tickers/names to ids yourself.

limit.description: How many articles to return, 1–20, default 10

type.description: Whether this is a news item or an educational guide
